name: Ikazaki Reia
source:
She was scouted as a model after a friend sent her photo to a fashion magazine without her permission, and moved to Tokyo from a small town. She quickly made her mark, selling magazine covers, selling photo books, and selling her own brand of clothing. However, despite the glamour of her life, she was often frustrated by the stresses of human relationships and the ugliness she saw in people.
 
The emotions that she suppressed through the accumulation of such daily experiences awakened her latent P/A abilities. Her ability is powerful, she was not able to control it immediately and began to hurt those around her regardless of whether she wanted to or not.

As a result, bad rumors began to circulate, and she was unable to continue her modeling career. The headmaster of the school, Jougasaki, couldn't bear to see this happen, so she was transferred to her school and, of her own volition, ended up studying in the "special" classroom.

She is cool and doesn't talk much, she is popular with the other female students. Despite her appearance, she likes cute things.

P/A: Mental damage

Hobbies: collecting weapon accessories, pretty things and shoes
Special skill: Posing
Likes: Cute things, metallic things, spiked bats
Dislikes: sweet things, carbohydrates, slugs

[From [url=https://www.empress-game.com/PA/top.html]official site[/url]]
